title: In WWII, America Tried to Bomb Japan With Fire-Bomb Bats

scenes.text: America once tried to bomb Japan with bats.
It was called Project X-Ray, and the US Army approved it in 1943.
Each bat carried a tiny incendiary bomb strapped to its chest.
The plan was to drop them over Japan, so they'd roost in wooden buildings and start fires.
Then a test went wrong. Escaped bats set fire to a hangar and a general's car.
The project cost about two million dollars before it was cancelled.

description:
America once tried to bomb Japan with bats.
In World War Two, Project X-Ray strapped tiny incendiary bombs to bats. In one test, escaped bats set fire to a hangar and a general's car. The project was cancelled after costing about two million dollars.
Would this have worked? Tell us below.
first_comment: The bombs weighed about one ounce each. What's the strangest military idea you've ever heard of?
